description: This Java class defines a generic failure handler for a vert.x web application, specifically handling ServiceInvocationException and other errors during HTTP request processing. It sets appropriate HTTP status codes and messages in responses based on the type of failure encountered.

classes.name: DefaultFailureHandler
classes.description: A handler that processes failed HTTP requests, setting appropriate status codes and messages based on the exception type.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method invoked when a routing failure occurs; inspects the failure and responds accordingly.

methods.name: sendError
methods.description: Utility method to send an error response with a specific status code and message.
